We can confirm that Omar Mateen had been employed by G4S since September 10th, 2007.

What began as an active shooter situation later turned into a hostage-taking situation when the perpetrator barricaded himself and victims in a bathroom. Around 5 a.m., law enforcement officers killed the shooter.
